Stamp the parts used by spells, machines and infusion.
Make the parts, assemble a golem and pilot it.
Build the stamper. It uses redstone and needs no worker.

Craft a Circuit Stamper and place a lever beside it. You can do this while your crystals grow; it does not need a Soul Well.\
\
Follow the component entries from Splinters to Conduits, then Control Circuits.

Stand at the open front, with the hinge at the back. Aim at a recess floor and right-click to place one item. Empty-hand right-click takes that item back.\
\
Patterns are shown from this side: top left and top right are nearest the hinge.

Turn the lever on to stamp. Turn it off to open the lid, then right-click to collect the output. Collect it before starting another batch.\
\
A wrong pattern leaves its ingredients intact. Follow the component arrows for more parts, or make [Foci](entry://anima:codex/components/soul_focus) to cast spells.
Stamp one Soulbone into six Splinters.
Combine Splinters and redstone to make Conduits.
Stamp a Blue Gem and three Conduits into a Control Circuit.
Use a Yellow Crystal to stamp Foci for spellcasting.
Make Emitters for Quantifiers and machines.
Blow a Yellow Gem and make a Ponderance Lattice.
Use two Emitters, a Yellow Crystal and a Control Circuit.
Stamp four stone blocks into four Stone Rings.
Make portable storage for bottled souls.
Optional: turn skeleton bone drops into Soulbone.

The Soulbone Spear matches an Iron Spear's combat stats and 250 durability.\
\
When its kill would drop normal bones, those drops become Soulbone instead. Skeletons are useful for this even though they have no harvestable soul.
Optional: make a reusable village finder.
Compare distance readings while searching for a village.

Right-click the Village Detector to report horizontal distance to the nearest generated village. It gives no direction or coordinates. Walk some distance and scan again to compare.\
\
It is reusable and has a two-second cooldown. Its stamping pattern is in [Make a Village Detector](entry://anima:codex/components/village_detector).
Build a Golem Part Assembler and a redstone switch.
Put one ingredient on each side holder, in any order. Power a valid recipe for two seconds to assemble it. Invalid recipes stay idle.
Empty-hand use removes a holder's item. Right-click the output to collect and reopen the holders, even while powered. Pulse redstone again for the next batch.
Follow the connected part entries to make plates, joints and the finished body parts.
Tools must be undamaged and are consumed. One golem needs a head, a torso, two arms and two legs.
Compress four stone blocks into one plate.
Combine three stone plates with a piston.
Make the eye with two Yellow Gems and a Control Circuit.
Assemble the thrust unit for the core.
Add a Quantifier, chest and plate to the thrust unit.
Make one Head with an Oculus, two armored plates and an anvil.
Make one Torso with a Core and three armored plates.
Make two Arms. Each consumes an undamaged Iron Pickaxe.
Make two arms for each golem. The pickaxe must be undamaged and is consumed during assembly.
Make two Legs with armored plates and joints.
Make two legs for each golem.
